label: <button type="button" class="btn" style="margin-left:5px; transition: all 0.2s; display:inline-block;" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();try{var ta=document.getElementById('message');if(!ta||!ta.value){UI.ErrorMessage('❗ Brak danych',2000);return false;}if(!this.dataset.copied){var txt=ta.value.replace(/\\/g,'');var btn=this;navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(function(){UI.SuccessMessage('📋 Skopiowano!',2000);btn.dataset.copied='true';btn.innerHTML='✅ Otwórz Bazę';btn.style.setProperty('background','linear-gradient(#5cad5c 0%, #2e7a2e 30%, #1f5c1f 80%, #0f2e0f 100%)','important');}).catch(function(e){UI.ErrorMessage('⚠️ Błąd kopiowania',2000);});}else{var rawTxt=ta.value.replace(/\\/g,'');this.dataset.copied='';this.innerHTML='🛡️ Import';this.style.background='';var w=window.open('https://twdatabase.online/reports','_blank','noopener,noreferrer');if(w){var t=setInterval(function(){try{if(w.document){var inp=w.document.querySelector('.import-textarea');if(inp){var s=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(w.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set;s.call(inp,rawTxt);inp.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('input',{bubbles:true}));clearInterval(t);}}}catch(e){}},300);}}return false;}catch(err){UI.ErrorMessage('❗ Błąd: '+err.message,2500);return false;}">🛡️ Import</button>
